description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class C4 (house in multiple occupation - HMO) (RETROSPECTIVE).
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:SCSD0306_0459 A-06SCSD0306_0459 A-03SCSD0306_0459 A-04SCSD0306_0459 A-01SCSD0306_0459 A-05SCSD0306_0459 A-02SCSD0306_0459 A-00DESIGN AND ACCESS STATEMENTReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The use hereby approved shall operate only as a Class C4 House in Multiple Occupation and shall be occupied by no more than six residents at any one time.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen / dining rooms shall be retained in perpetuity.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the amenity of neighbours and the residential character of the surrounding area.

Within one month of the date of this permission, waste storage and recycling facilities sufficient to meet the needs of the approved development shall be provided and made available for use within the site in accordance with Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). The facilities shall thereafter be retained and maintained for those purposes for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets

The existing outbuilding located within the rear garden of the site shall be used solely for purposes incidental to the occupation and enjoyment of the HMO and shall not be used as independent living accommodation, sleeping accommodation, a separate dwelling unit, or for any other primary use.Reason: To ensure that the outbuilding remains ancillary to the lawful use of the site and to safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and the character of the area.

Within three months of the date of this permission, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, secure and covered cycle parking facilities shall be provided and made available for use in accordance with the following requirements:Provision of a minimum of six long-stay cycle parking spaces;Located in an accessible and convenient location with a minimum clear access width of 1.2 metres to enable cycles to be wheeled into the store;Served by a step-free route passing through no more than two doors or gates (excluding the entrance to the cycle store);Fully enclosed, comprising four walls and a roof, to provide appropriate security and weather protection.The cycle parking facilities shall thereafter be retained and maintained for cycle parking purposes and shall not be used for any other purpose without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.
